T. lhan skyes; S. sahaja. Connate, congenital. Originally applied to amitan which were born simultaneously with the Buddha (friends, teachers, a horse, etc. ). In the Vacir Kølgen the term acquired an esoteric meaning.
T. gnyis skyes; S. dvija. Originally one belonging to the uppermost caste of the Hindus (brahmana ) ; oviparous.
T. skye med pa; S. anutpada. Not born, without origination
